Learn more Why AI Governance? As organizations increasingly embrace AI technologies, it becomes crucial to ensure ethical use. Regulatory compliance assurance Ensure adherence to the EU AI Act while also maintaining the flexibility to create policies that align with other relevant AI regulations. Enhanced transparency and trust Foster confidence among stakeholders by providing thorough documentation, clear explanations of AI decision-making processes, and effective compliance reporting. Centralized AI inventory management Establish and maintain a robust AI inventory system, allowing for effective tracking and oversight of all AI models.
